name: q3_migration_20261028
problem_statement_note: 缺陷化合物以所列 DMS/Diacetyl/4VG/trans-2-nonenal/Stale hops 等超阈值项为准
lambda_selection: largest lambda whose projected spectrum is still nearest to the target-style centroid; fallback = smallest target-centroid distance

criteria.A: set form of the problem note: the set of over-threshold defects does not expand and the severity of each over-threshold defect does not increase
criteria.B: per-defect severity e_after <= e_before with e(c, T) = max(c / T - 1, 0)
criteria.C: aggregated severity sum_d e_after <= sum_d e_before

defect_projection.missing_source: cap = min(target-style median, 0.9 * threshold), flagged conditional
defect_projection.note: 0.9 x threshold headroom is a modelling choice, not a measured safety limit

style_identifiability_expected: tasting_category_fine is weakly separable in the supplied coordinates; accuracy is reported, not used as a hard gate
honesty: A migrated spectrum is a statistical destination inside the supplied coordinate space, not a brewing recipe and not a measured beer; the projection certifies only the listed defect coordinates at the 0.9 x threshold headroom and does not certify physical brewability or sensory acceptance.

evidence_grading.defect_status_rule: severity e(c,T)=max(c/T-1,0) on the median threshold: improved if e_after<e_before, worse if e_after>e_before, unchanged otherwise; trans-2-nonenal has no threshold and Stale hops has no coordinate, so both are 'unknown'
evidence_grading.style_nearest_centroid_rule: target = migrated spectrum is nearest to the target centroid; source_baseline = still nearest to Pils/Lager; other = another style centroid
evidence_grading.style_diagnostic_supported_rule: a target style's diagnostic supports a case only if all 11 source beers migrate to that centroid (Kriek 11/11); Tripel 0/11 and Lambic 2/11 are reported as unsupported

claim_level_rule.model_supported: A/B/C pass and nearest centroid is the target style and the target style diagnostic supports all 11 cases and no evaluated defect worsened and no conditional cap was used
claim_level_rule.conditional: A/B/C pass but at least one of: style diagnostic unsupported, an evaluated defect worsened, conditional diacetyl cap used

evidence_grading.note: these are labelling rules for the evidence table; they do not change the migration math, the lambda grid, the projection or the A/B/C criteria

sensory_pipeline.entry: beer_models.inference.run (same call as scripts/current.py predict --task q1)

q1_model_grade_semantics.note: estimated_grade_0_6 is the official decision layer: non-forced high-grade top-k from cumulative probability with parent-child caps. It is not the legacy integer conditional median (kept in grade_legacy_integer_median).

sensory_pipeline.note: full-training-model predictions are not out-of-sample accuracy estimates; grade_raw is the official decision-layer grade (top-k high grades with 24 parent-child caps), prob_ge5/prob_6 are the decision-layer probabilities, and prob_ge5_risk_head/prob_6_risk_head are the legacy calibrated risk-head probabilities kept for traceability
